long.text: Claim the lookout rock and be the first to see whoever comes up the beach.
long.reason: Anything with a view that high should belong to me, and I found it first.

steps.reason: Something new with a flat top is worth sitting next to, and I will pretend I only came by accident.
The sky is the biggest thing here, and someone should check whether it is looking back.
Wet orange clay is the best material on the island, and I intend to have some before anyone asks.
A piece of clay in my paws is a piece of clay I keep.
I will make something out of the clay so the workbench has a reason to exist.
Making things is tiring, and a warm patch of sun is owed to me.
I will go and check that the lookout rock is still mine before the afternoon gets away from me.

today.reason: I will inspect the new things on the island, make something from clay, and finish by checking on the lookout rock, with a long nap in the sun in the middle.
